0022600132.text: The Heat (0-4, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Atlanta Hawks (2-2) for their fifth game of the season, with Miami 0-3 at home, 0-1 on the road, and 15th in the East. Miami is without Simone Fontecchio (illness), while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and the Hawks, second in the Southeast and one game back, have lost their last two. This season's series has no games yet, but the Heat won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 143-117 win in Miami on April 12, 2026.
